messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The user cannot save a claim after opening it.
  quote: Claims: click "Open"...Claims: click "Save", rage x3
- problem: The Save button in the Claims section is not functioning correctly, causing user frustration.
  quote: Claims: click "Details" ... click "Save", rage x3
- problem: The Save button on the Reports page is causing frustration and likely not functioning correctly.
  quote: Reports: click "Save", rage x3
- problem: The claim details page requires multiple clicks and causes frustration.
  quote: Claim details: click "Next"...Claim details: click "Save", rage x3
- problem: The Save button on the Reports page is causing frustration and likely not functioning correctly.
  quote: Reports: click "Save", rage x3
